name: Terrametric
tagline: Live crop-stress scores, a two-week yield forecast and a prescription for each field.

awards: Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless
Best Intermediate Data Science Track Hack - Bitcamp

problem: Farm managers lack actionable, current field-stress insight.
solution: Scores field stress with gradient-boosted models, forecasts yield over 14 days and prescribes actions, shown on a 3D globe and mobile app.
demo_moment: Team-described: fields light up by stress and a prescription appears.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Real World Prize - Ambrook” and “Best Champion of Open Source w/ Featherless - Featherless” and “Best Intermediate Data Science Track Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Won three prizes including a real-world award.

lessons: Score, forecast and prescribe in one view.
